dct_title_s: South America, Brazil--south coast, Ilha de São Sebastião to Ilha de Bom Abrigo (Raster Image)
dct_description_sm: Prepared and published by the National Imagery and Mapping Agency. Depths shown by isolines and soundings. Relief shown by form lines and spot heights. "From a Brazilian chart of 1994." Not distributed to depository libraries. Place names in Portuguese with glossary in English. "Copyright 1998 by the United States government. No copyright claimed under Title 17 U.S.C." "Soundings in meters." Includes tidal information. Insets: I. de Alcatrazes. Scale 1:99,558 -- I. do Guaraú. Scale 1:55,059. Map No.24140
This map is part of a collection of scanned and georeferenced nautical charts produced by the National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency (NGA).
